title: The Last Birthday II
author: Due-Nature9853
selftext:
🐰 MEET MR. MORROW

"Come on, everybody! It's time for another birthday!"

Once the beloved mascot of Candlewick's Celebration Palace, Mr. Morrow was created to bring happiness to every child's birthday.

But behind that familiar smile lies something far more disturbing.

He remembers the children.

He remembers the Palace.

And he remembers everything.

🎂 THE LAST BIRTHDAY II: THE THINGS WE BURIED

🎮 FREE DEMO — NOVEMBER 13, 2026

🩸 FULL GAME — NOVEMBER 20, 2026

A DeadLetterStudios production.

Some birthdays should never be remembered.

\#MrMorrow #TheLastBirthday #DeadLetterStudios #IndieHorror #HorrorGaming #PsychologicalHorror

comments.body:
Hey u/Due-Nature9853, this falls under Rule 4. Commercial posts are okay here, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).
